question: Does the explicit published-author Betula/Pinus target panel have complete source-owned count support on the same six windows across all seven retained cores, and bind one coherent author parameter profile, before any Swedish-only versus four-country physical comparison?
scientific_consumer: A new declared author-target harmonization prerequisite for a possible matched physical comparison. It does not rerun or replace the qualified literal Betula/Ulmus audit, prior direct-pollen transfer, or existing three-place forward-pollen results.
external_input_root_role: Explicit original_data_root supplied by the caller; author source paths below are relative to this one shared original root, not copied into the repository.

author_lookup_contract.source_binding: Use the exact retained author lookup. Consistent duplicate source-name assignments are allowed; conflicting duplicates, missing required native-name mappings or unexpected additional measured concepts mapping onto this two-target panel refuse. Do not lowercase, infer synonyms, collapse missing native rows or assert botanical equivalence.

parameters.binding: Bind all31 unique ordered A.series labels in mean and covariance files, with matching row/column axes, finite positive means/fall speeds and a symmetric nonnegative covariance diagonal. Preserve source strings and the selected exact2x2 block; line6/22 include the header. Do not substitute rounded published-table values or interpret the profile as an approved local PPE.

population.shared_physical_family: SOLS81/83 collection units4303/4304 belong to one site3432. Keep separate core ledgers; never pool or count them as independent places.

chronology_policy: Use each explicit selected ID/name/type above, preserve every source age wrapper/declaration/default flag and native collection reference. ABB/BOKE/BUS legitimately select their collection reference; other cores select explicit calibrated alternatives. Multiple source defaults across age types are retained without silently selecting an alternate model. BP reference is1950 CE, not preparation/publication year. These source points do not authenticate historical LandClim vectors or a joint age posterior.
bound_policy: A finite source-selected point may have absent/null uncertainty bounds. Preserve absence versus null and all signed original bounds; present bounds must be finite and contain the point. Missing, duplicate, incompatible, invalid or conflicting selected points are unassignable. SOLSOE81 owner352996 point7BP/younger-41 remains native outside-window context; its prior field-comparability refusal is not a missing point, cannot suppress these windows and cannot justify substituting its uncalibrated720BP alternative.
owner_and_window_policy: Retain all542 ordered native sample/analysis-unit/depth/thickness owners and all native ages. Assign exact finite selected points to fixed half-open windows. Negative/outside-window states remain explicit. Any unassignable selected-age owner suppresses all six windows of its own core only. Keep all42 requested windows including empty/refused ones; do not choose only complete-count samples, interpolate, calibrate or create observations.
count_and_mass_policy: Reuse the established strict native pollen NISP/count eligibility and full-mass policy. Inspect every native pollen datum against the complete lookup; retain original datum index, taxonID/name, count state/value and mapping evidence for the selected author targets, with complete source mass and explicit rejected/excluded classifications. Required per-core native concepts are declared above, not discovered by outcome optimization. Missing/null/invalid/duplicate counts are not measured zero. The two-axis panel NISP, full source pollen NISP and excluded mass must reconcile where defined; incomplete panel mass and composition remain null. Original counts, authorship/use metadata and full populations remain unchanged.
aggregation_policy: For every core/window emit ordered native members, selected-age disposition, original native count-axis evidence, source-supported author target totals, complete panel/full/excluded mass if defined and explicit empty/incomplete/zero/invalid/unassignable refusals. Keep whole-core subtotals separate from complete window support. Publish no fit, kernel, prediction or score.
preservation_and_reuse: Existing literal-window source contracts and qualified outputs remain unchanged. Extract reusable pure native-window mechanics under their durable owner instead of copying a second engine. Do not invoke the broad31-target preparation path whose absent-target initialization is zero. Existing source and chronology qualification is reused in its real scope; no source acquisition, materialization, native census or archive copy.
rights_and_attribution: Retain exact native dataset/contact/citation metadata and the author-source identities. Local curation of retained sources and a published-author lookup do not confer new analytical or redistribution rights, native species determination, field admission, historical equivalence or scientific endorsement. Detailed owner/count products remain local artifacts; commit no raw source table.
guards: Before and after producer and independent observer, require exact source/protocol/runner identities, consumed tracked Python, HEAD/index and all opened input bytes. Read the four raw parts sequentially, reuse shared originals and preserve source bytes. Every result and owner/core/window partition is closed and independently checked; no network or source writes.
